Tags

Filter the BeatSaver catalog by tag - this is where poodle / tech / midspeed style lists come from. Click once to require a tag, again to exclude it. BeatSaver has a dedicated Poodle tag, so just click it and Search.

BeatLeader sorts ranked maps by style. Pick one or more to keep only those. Unranked maps have no style, so they drop out while one is picked.

How it works

Playlist Studio is a free Beat Saber playlist tool and builder that runs right in your browser. Pick a search source, filter, Search, add the maps you want to Your Playlist, then export a .bplist. Two sources: BeatLeader for scores, PP and your play history, or BeatSaver to browse by tags and genres. You're not stuck with everything that matches, so cherry-pick, mix results from several searches, drag rows to reorder, then export just your picks. Already know the maps you want? Paste their BSR codes into Quick Add. New to mods? The BSMG wiki walks you through installing them on PC and Quest.

For You

Connect your BeatLeader profile and Studio picks maps for your level: pp gains, a rank-up plan and practice sets built from your own plays.

Top PP Gains

Ranked maps you haven't played, ranked by the weighted PP they would add. Predicted from how your accuracy scales with stars, priced through the same PP curve as the rest of the app. Connect your profile, set the band in Star Rating, then hit Find PP gains.
Star band comes from the Star Rating panel. Leave it at the default and the optimizer auto-centers on your comfort-to-stretch zone.
Your PP targets show up here.
Connect your BeatLeader profile, then hit Find PP gains. Studio charts your accuracy curve and lists the unplayed ranked maps that add the most pp.

Rank-Up Planner

Set a goal and get the fewest ranked maps that reach it, with a projected new PP and rank. Needs your BeatLeader profile connected. Projections reuse the accuracy model behind Top PP Gains.

AccSaber Pools

The ranked AccSaber charts with their complexity, straight from AccSaber. Load a pool as results, then use the Your plays chips to find the ones you haven't played or FC'd.

Quick Add

Already know the maps? Paste one or more BSR codes, BeatSaver links, or map hashes to drop them straight into Your Playlist - no searching. Paste a playlist link to load a whole playlist. Perfect for tournament pools and shared code lists. Looks up maps on BeatSaver.

Separate multiple with spaces or commas. Accepts BSR codes, beatsaver.com/maps/… links, 40-character hashes, and playlist links: beatsaver.com/playlists/…, a hosted Playlist Studio link or any link to a .bplist file.

Songs download in game. The file lists the songs, it doesn't contain them. In game, open the playlist and use PlaylistManager's download button to grab the ones you don't have.

Drop the file into your Beat Saber Playlists folder (on PC usually …\Steam\steamapps\common\Beat Saber\Playlists\), then refresh your song list in-game. Needs the PlaylistManager mod.

Playing on Quest? The free Studio Sync mod sends playlists from here to your headset. Or copy the file to ModData/com.beatgames.beatsaber/Mods/PlaylistManager/Playlists on the headset with SideQuest, or turn on In-Game Sync so the headset pulls updates itself.

✓
Sent. Next time, skip the cable.The free Studio Sync mod sends playlists from here to your Quest over Wi-Fi, downloads missing songs for you, and lets you edit the playlists already on the headset. Setup takes about two minutes.

Skip the cable: the free Studio Sync mod sends playlists from here to your Quest over the internet.

Plug your Quest into this computer with a USB cable and use Chrome or Edge. Developer mode needs to be on, which modding already did. Studio finds your PlaylistManager folder on the headset and drops the playlist in. Restart Beat Saber to see a new playlist.

First time: put the headset on after you pick it. It asks Allow USB debugging? for this browser. Tick Always allow from this computer and tap Allow. This is separate from SideQuest or adb on this PC, so it shows up once even if those already work.

No cable handy? Download the .bplist and copy it to ModData/com.beatgames.beatsaber/Mods/PlaylistManager/Playlists on the headset with SideQuest. Turn on In-Game Sync and later updates come down with the in-game Sync button, no cable needed.

Studio Sync

Quest mod
A free mod for Beat Saber on Quest. Playlists you build here go straight onto the headset with no cable or file copying, and you can edit the ones already on it from here.

  1. Install the mod

    Installed it with ModsBeforeFriday or QuestPatcher? Go on to step 2.

    Download Studio Sync0.9.2 · Beat Saber 1.40.8

    On a PC or Android phone, open ModsBeforeFriday in Chrome or Edge and plug in your Quest. Choose Upload Files and pick the .qmod. It adds PlaylistCore, BSML and SongCore for you. QuestPatcher works too.

    You're in the headset browser, so do this step from a PC or phone.

  2. Link your headset

    In game, open the Mods tab in the panel left of song select, pick Studio Sync and press Link. Type the 6-character code it shows.

    Already linked on your computer? No need to link again.

    On the device that's linked, open Use Studio Sync on your phone at the bottom of Studio Sync and scan its code, or paste its key here:

  3. Send playlists

    Build one in Your Playlist and press Send to Quest here. It lands on the headset the next time the game syncs, and the mod downloads any songs you don't have.

Use Studio Sync on your phone or another computer
Scan with your phone's cameraPlaylist Studio opens on your phone already linked to your headsets. Nothing to copy.This code works like a password: don't post it or share a screenshot.
or copy the key

Key shared somewhere it shouldn't be? Make a new one. Your headsets stay linked; other browsers and scripts using the old key stop working until you give them the new one.

Share

Share linkone-time copy

Packs the maps into the link itself. No hosting, no account. Whoever opens it gets the playlist as it is right now, so it's great for tournament pools and sending a set to a friend.

Hosted linkstays up to date

Studio keeps a copy online and writes its address into the file as its sync link. Get the file onto your headset once (Download or Send to Quest), then PlaylistManager's in-game Sync pulls every update you host. On Quest, the Studio Sync mod skips that first step, and its Sync from uses the same link.

Use my own host instead

The address your .bplist will live at. Studio only writes it into the file; you upload the file there yourself. It must serve the raw file, not a web page, and stay the same.
